category_title: Students who feel misunderstood and engage in off-task social behavior during tutoring
scenario_title: After-school math tutoring session with off-task social behavior
minimal_context: Beaumont is attending an after-school math tutoring session to copy class notes and complete his math work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Beaumont, it is time to start. Please take out your math assignment and copy the notes from class today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have my math notebook with me. Let me just look through my backpack to find a pencil and some paper so I can get ready.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, please find what you need and begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually don’t know what is happening a lot during class anyway because I am kinda late usually or not paying attention. I learn differently.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to focus on the math work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to the student at the next desk) Hey, what are you working on? Look at this. I know I just have to stop messing around when I go, but I'm still preparing my stuff. My teacher doesn’t help the ones that are screwing around anyway – I get kicked out a lot [laughing].
